scope: Sequential main-thread review of the actual ambient-identity fixture repair
checks: Same owned windows/amd64 identity is used for the passing native control and architecture negative.
The negative changes only requested architecture to arm64; existing host/OS/shell/CGO/compiler identities stay valid.
Exit 1 and exact architecture diagnostic are mandatory.
Output is copied before expect truncates its capture file.
No production/workflow implementation, dependency, tool pin or product acceptance threshold changes.
limitations: The controlled Windows identity runs in Linux Bash; actual native Windows must still rerun.
